$comment: eigen_work_v2.0 = harness repo for the Daylight plugin (`daylight`). The factory is NOT dogfooded on itself until built: superpowers routes the work here; design lives in docs/design/. model: sonnet keeps the coordinator off Opus by default (switch with /model opus for hard design calls). ENABLE_STOP_REVIEW=0 stops the security-guidance per-turn Opus review; run /security-review once per PR instead. CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 is required by the design (interactive conductor) — Claude Code may only honour it from ~/.claude/settings.json; `daylight doctor` will check. Permissions: read-only/dev-loop commands allowed; pushes, merges, repo creation and deploy teardown ask; force-push, push to main and secret reads denied (mirrors the factory's own push_guard/judge_guard).
